edits.before: - Jinx Flame Chompers!: matchup-defining — The chompers flip any engage onto her into a counter-kill — walk around, never through. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Beat Drop has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: Flame Chompers! (E) is a rough 24s cooldown early, dropping only to 10s at max rank — engage outside the live field, not through it, and track the timer out loud. Her R sits at 85-45s. She sustains chip damage through lifesteal on autos, so time Grievous Wounds into any extended trade.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Cast W for the shield, then let the echo heal — it outlasts her lifesteal-sustained chip damage in extended trades.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Standing in front eats a Flame Chompers root meant for your support's peel angle.
